name: Allergic Reaction
description: A sudden response by the immune system to allergens such as food, insect bites, or medications.
immediate_steps: Call emergency services if breathing difficulty occurs

name: Asthma Attack
description: Sudden narrowing of airways leading to breathing difficulty.
immediate_steps: Call emergency services if symptoms worsen

name: Bee Sting
description: Sting from a bee causing pain and possible allergic reaction.
immediate_steps: Wash area with soap and water
Apply cold pack to reduce swelling

name: Blisters
description: Fluid-filled bumps on skin caused by friction, burns, or irritation.
immediate_steps: Seek medical help if infection occurs

name: Dehydration
description: Loss of body fluids leading to imbalance in electrolytes.
immediate_steps: Give water or oral rehydration solution

name: Heat Exhaustion
description: Body overheats due to prolonged exposure to high temperatures.
immediate_steps: Move person to a cooler place
Use cold compress on neck and head
Call medical help if symptoms persist

name: Hypothermia
description: Dangerously low body temperature due to prolonged cold exposure.

name: Seizure
description: Sudden uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain causing convulsions.
immediate_steps: Do not put anything in mouth
Call emergency services if first seizure or lasts >5 minutes

name: Eye Injury
description: Trauma or foreign object in the eye causing pain or vision issues.
immediate_steps: Rinse gently with clean water or saline
Cover with eye shield if necessary

name: Burning Eyes (Chemical Exposure)
description: Chemical substance contacts the eye causing irritation or damage.
immediate_steps: Flush eye with plenty of clean water for 15-20 minutes

name: Splinters
description: Small piece of material embedded in skin.

name: Nose Fracture
description: Break in the bones of the nose due to trauma.
immediate_steps: Do not try to straighten nose

name: Fainting (Syncope)
description: Temporary loss of consciousness caused by decreased blood flow to the brain.
immediate_steps: Lay person flat and elevate legs
Seek medical attention if recurrent or prolonged

name: Insect Bite (Non-Allergic)
description: Bites from insects causing mild irritation or swelling.
immediate_steps: Wash area with soap and water
Apply cold pack to reduce swelling

name: Ear Injury
description: Trauma or foreign object in the ear.
immediate_steps: Do not insert objects into ear
Seek medical attention for foreign objects or severe pain

name: Chilblains
description: Skin sores caused by repeated exposure to cold, non-freezing temperatures.

name: Sprained Ankle
description: Injury to ligaments of the ankle due to twisting or overstretching.
immediate_steps: Rest and avoid weight on ankle

name: Blunt Head Injury
description: Injury to the head without penetration of the skull.
immediate_steps: Seek medical evaluation immediately if loss of consciousness or vomiting occurs

name: Poisoning (Household Chemicals)
description: Ingestion, inhalation, or skin exposure to toxic household chemicals.
immediate_steps: Do not induce vomiting unless advised
Rinse skin or eyes if exposed
Call poison control or emergency services immediately

name: Chapped Lips / Frostbite (Mild)
description: Mild frostbite or cold damage to lips, fingers, or toes.
immediate_steps: Warm area with body heat or lukewarm water

name: Sunburn
description: Skin damage caused by excessive exposure to UV rays.
immediate_steps: Use aloe vera or soothing lotion

name: Nail Injury
description: Trauma to fingernails or toenails causing pain or bleeding.
immediate_steps: Seek medical attention if nail is severely damaged

name: Animal Scratch
description: Scratch caused by an animal, risk of infection.
immediate_steps: Clean area with soap and water
Seek medical care if signs of infection appear

name: Electric Shock (Mild)
description: Exposure to electricity causing minor injury.
immediate_steps: Monitor for burns or cardiac symptoms
Seek medical care if symptoms persist

name: Nail Puncture
description: Penetrating injury from nails or sharp objects.
immediate_steps: Seek medical attention for tetanus shot if necessary

name: Ingrown Toenail
description: Toenail grows into surrounding skin causing pain and swelling.

name: Sprained Wrist
description: Injury to wrist ligaments due to twisting or fall.

name: Cramps (Muscle)
description: Sudden involuntary contraction of a muscle.

name: Spider Bite
description: Bite from a spider causing local reaction or systemic symptoms.
immediate_steps: Clean bite with soap and water
Seek medical care if severe or spider is venomous

name: Foreign Object in Eye
description: Dust, dirt, or small particle in eye.
immediate_steps: Rinse with clean water or saline
Seek medical care if object does not flush out

name: Blunt Chest Injury
description: Impact to chest causing pain and possible breathing difficulty.
immediate_steps: Apply ice pack to reduce swelling

name: Burning Tongue
description: Pain from eating hot food or liquid.
immediate_steps: Seek medical care if blistering occurs

name: Choking on Small Object
description: Airway obstruction due to small objects like coins or toys.
immediate_steps: Call emergency services immediately if severe

name: Burned Lips
description: Mild burn to lips from hot food or liquid.
immediate_steps: Seek medical help if blistering occurs

name: Nose Foreign Object
description: Small object inserted into nostril causing discomfort.
immediate_steps: Try to blow object out gently
Seek medical help if object is stuck or breathing difficulty occurs

name: Bee Allergy (Severe)
description: Severe allergic reaction to bee sting.
immediate_steps: Keep person calm and lying down

name: Hypoglycemia
description: Low blood sugar in diabetic or non-diabetic persons.

name: Heat Stroke
description: Severe overheating of the body causing organ damage.
immediate_steps: Cool body with water or ice packs

name: Tick Bite
description: Bite from a tick which may transmit infection.
immediate_steps: Seek medical care if symptoms occur

name: Bruise (Contusion)
description: Discoloration of skin due to trauma without breaking skin.
immediate_steps: Monitor for severe swelling or increased pain

name: Foreign Object in Ear
description: Small objects like beads or insects entering the ear canal.
immediate_steps: Do not probe the ear with tools
Tilt head to try to dislodge gently
Seek medical attention if object does not come out or pain persists

name: Mild Concussion
description: Head injury causing temporary confusion or dizziness.
immediate_steps: Seek medical evaluation if symptoms persist

name: Ingrown Hair
description: Hair grows back into the skin causing inflammation.
immediate_steps: Do not squeeze or pick bump

name: Lip Laceration
description: Cut or tear on the lip caused by trauma.
immediate_steps: Apply gentle pressure to stop bleeding
Seek medical care if deep or bleeding persists

name: Blistered Feet
description: Painful fluid-filled bumps caused by friction or footwear.
immediate_steps: Apply protective bandage or blister pad

name: Severe Itching (Dermatitis)
description: Inflammation of the skin causing intense itching and redness.
immediate_steps: Use soothing lotion or anti-itch cream
Seek medical help if severe or persistent

name: Hangnail Infection
description: Infection around a torn piece of skin near fingernail.
immediate_steps: Seek medical care if infection worsens

name: Minor Burns from Hot Liquids
description: Burn caused by hot drinks, oil, or soup.
immediate_steps: Cool with running water for 10-15 minutes

name: Fingertip Laceration
description: Small cuts on fingertips from knives, glass, or tools.
immediate_steps: Seek medical care if cut is deep

name: Mild Frostbite on Hands
description: Cold injury causing tingling and numbness in fingers.
immediate_steps: Warm hands gradually with body heat or lukewarm water

name: Skin Rash from Plant Contact
description: Irritation caused by contact with plants like poison ivy.
immediate_steps: Wash area with soap and water
Seek medical care if widespread or infected

name: Minor Eye Irritation from Dust
description: Eye discomfort due to dust or small particles.
immediate_steps: Rinse with clean water or saline
Seek medical care if object persists

name: Finger Jam
description: Injury to finger joints from impact or collision.

name: Chapped Skin
description: Dry, cracked skin caused by cold, wind, or frequent washing.
immediate_steps: Seek medical care if infection occurs

name: Minor Bruising of Arm
description: Discoloration and swelling from a minor bump or hit.

name: Bee Sting (Non-Allergic)
description: Painful sting from a bee with localized reaction only.
immediate_steps: Wash area with soap and water

name: Splinter from Wood
description: Small piece of wood embedded in skin.

name: Minor Toothache
description: Pain in a tooth due to cavity or irritation.
immediate_steps: Take over-the-counter pain reliever if needed

name: Burning Hands from Hot Object
description: Mild burn caused by touching hot objects.

name: Minor Lip Swelling
description: Swelling of lips due to minor injury or irritation.
immediate_steps: Seek medical help if severe or persistent
